violation_type.title: Licensing must have access to records (26 TAC §745.8417)
violation_type.short_title: Licensing must have access to records
violation_type.typical_finding: Operation did not have files available as apart of the investigation.

finding_variants.text: Operation did not have files available as apart of the investigation.
